gloss: bit by bit; sparsely; in drops; here and there

definitions.gloss: bit by bit; little by little; gradually
definitions.explanation: Describes something happening slowly, one piece at a time, often in an unhurried or leisurely manner.
Describes things that are spread out with spaces between them, appearing intermittently.
Describes rain or liquid falling in scattered drops.

notes:
USAGE:
ぽつぽつ(と) + verb

Sense 1 (bit by bit):
・ぽつぽつ⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ (to speak bit by bit)
・ぽつぽつ⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧ (to start gradually)
・ぽつぽつ⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧ (to gather one by one)

Sense 2 (sparse distribution):
・⟦{白髪|しらが}→白髪：00369_shiraga⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぽつぽつ⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧ (gray hairs are appearing here and there)
・⟦{星|ほし}→星：01510_hoshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぽつぽつ⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧ (stars are visible scattered about)

Sense 3 (drops of rain or liquid):
・⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぽつぽつ (rain in scattered drops)

NUANCE:
Conveys a leisurely, unhurried pace with gaps between occurrences. Often suggests something is just beginning or is happening intermittently.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・⟦ぽつりぽつり→ぽつりぽつり：noentry⟧ - a variant with much the same meaning
・⟦ちらほら→ちらほら：noentry⟧ - here and there, scattered (of things seen)
・⟦ぼちぼち→ぼちぼち：05311_bochibochi⟧ - bit by bit; so-so (common in Kansai speech)
